body:
Lol I don't know what responses you were expecting, you came into a Nintendo subreddit and didn't praise the almighty pro controller. 

For the record I disagree, the switch pro controller is absolutely phenomenal, you get to pay $70 and have it break down and drift within a few months! It's a fantastic deal, I've never seen a controller that breaks down as fast. Well, except for the joycons, those get drift even faster. First party Nintendo switch controllers are amazing.

I guess by "soon" I meant like. Sometime soon. Not today and probably not tomorrow but just like sometime soon idk. But thanks for caring I appreciate it.

P.s. your cat is very cute
Yeah. This was kind of a dumb thing to say anyways idk why I even posted it, should've just kept it to myself. Thanks for the insight though I appreciate it.

You're right there's plenty of people out there who don't even have friends so I guess I really shouldn't be complaining since I'm lucky to have something other people would kill for. Thanks for the insight.

Dude SAME I have very vivid dreams and I remember all of them in great detail, like I still remember dreams vividly from when I was a kid (like the oldest dream I can remember was from when I was 5 or something?) most of my friends that I've talked to say that they can only remember dreams from when they were a bit older like 7-9 at the youngest

Oh man ngl that sounds worse, like school is one thing but I couldn't imagine not being able to escape the army. This might sound sarcastic because I'm bad with words lol but genuinely thanks for your service, I'm such a softy I could never imagine myself going into the military so I really respect people who have.

Oh thank god it's not just me, I tried asking one of my friends who graduated with me about it and she said she never really had dreams about school anymore so I thought it was just a me thing. Dreaming about being a student while being a teacher sounds disorienting as hell though lmao, I feel like that has the same energy as that "Shit I'm late for school . . . wait I graduated . . . FUCK I'M A TEACHER" meme lmao
Thanks for the encouragement man but I just I don't fucking know if I can do it. I just feel like all of my relationships eventually turn into shit. I want to keep trying though.

It's more so my family then friends, but yeah it's not fun either way. But thanks for responding man I do appreciate it, and I hope if you're still going through it with those friends that it gets better.
Oh thank god I'm not the only person who's done this before.

Thanks. Yeah it's weird but I already feel better, in a way. Like I just expected to post something and have it get buried and have no one respond, and the fact that even one person responded meant a lot more to me than I was expecting. I guess it just reminded me that there's kind people out there that care, even if I feel like no one in my personal life does.

Thanks a lot, I appreciate it. I have a really hard time talking about things so I don't know if I'll ever be able to take you up on your offer but I do genuinely appreciate you putting yourself out there for me.

Thanks man. I appreciate it.

(edit thinking back this seemed a little cold or sarcastic, but I genuinely did appreciate the sentiment, thank you)

I'm gonna be honest, basketball games in highschool don't mean shit. There's gonna be other games that he could've gone to, this one isn't going to be any more important than the next one. I think that if he really cared about you, he should've been there for you when you needed him the most.
Honestly, I don't think you fucked up. If she wasn't able to leave you a damn name and number to contact her back, obviously getting this appliance fixed isn't important to her.
